input.quote: Upon the date of termination, all Customer payment obligations accrued hereunder through the date of termination will become due and payable. The termination of selected Service Option Attachments will not affect Customer's obligation to pay charges under other Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: This is a hosting/services agreement, but § 3.5 (Effect of Termination) deals only with accrued payment obligations; searches for "transition", "return", and "delete" turn up no exit-assistance, data-export, or deletion-certification obligation anywhere (§ 11.6 only allocates Content responsibility to Customer, and § 14.2 merely survives § 3.5 as drafted). With no data return right at all, the Agreement falls into walk-away territory, so we insert the preferred exit provision: up to six months' transition assistance at IBM's then-current rates, return of Content in machine-readable format within 30 days, and deletion with written certification thereafter. Fallback of 90 days' assistance is available in negotiation.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and Content return/deletion obligation into § 3.5 Effect of Termination.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 3.5 addresses only accrued charges, so we added an exit provision requiring IBM to provide transition assistance for up to six months at then-current rates, return our Content in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and then delete and certify deletion. Our playbook requires data return and migration help on exit; we can accept 90 days of assistance if six months is an issue.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason, IBM shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at IBM's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return all Content and other Customer data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Content and Customer data from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.
